# Trusted Pegasus: "Whenever this creature attacks, target attacking creature without flying gains
# flying until end of turn."  (Flying: the compiler's keyword, kept.)
# Event: Library Larcenist's "Whenever this creature attacks" (B2b-library-larcenist). Effect: Gale
# Swooper's "target creature gains flying until end of turn" (B2a-gale-swooper) with the target narrowed
# by Warded Battlements' IS_ATTACKING and Destructive Tampering's "without flying".
trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=DeclareAttackersEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
        'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.FLYING),
        'duration': DurationEot(),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAnd(children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_ATTACKING),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.KEYWORD_HAS, keyword=Keyword.FLYING)),
            )),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [trigger, *compiled]
